description: Download a single attachment. By default returns inline base64 (max_size_mb default 5, ceiling 25). Pass save_to to write the file to a sandboxed local directory instead and get back only {path, filename, mimeType, size, sha256} — use this for anything large (video, audio, big PDFs) or anything local tools need as a file. File attachments only — Microsoft item/reference attachments return NOT_SUPPORTED.

filename.description: On-disk filename to use with save_to (sanitized). Defaults to the attachment's sanitized name.

max_size_mb.description: Size cap in MB. Inline default 5, inline ceiling 25; with save_to the default and ceiling are 150.

save_to.description: Directory to write the file into instead of returning base64. Sandboxed like body_file and attachment paths: relative paths resolve against the working directory only; directories in an AGENT_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DIRS root must be given as an ABSOLUTE path (a leading ~ is not expanded). Missing subdirectories are created. Existing files are never overwritten — a collision gets a numeric suffix (report.pdf, report-1.pdf, …).

name: download_attachment
